title: Oshi Health: what it treats, what it costs, and a physician by message
summary: Oshi Health reviews and cost: NP or PA video visits, a year usually billed as 4 specialist visits, $150 self-pay (Nov 2026) vs $40 FutureClinic physician.
body_markdown:
Your first Oshi Health visit is by video with a nurse practitioner or physician assistant "under the guidance of a gastroenterologist" ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ), plus dietitians and gut-brain specialists by referral ([Oshi Health](https://help.oshihealth.com/enrollment/what-is-oshi-health/) ). Oshi usually bills insurance as four specialist visits for a year, or $150 self-pay per visit as of November 2026 ([Oshi pricing](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) ). On[FutureClinic](https://futureclinic.com/) , a physician answers by message for $40, or a chosen doctor's listed price, typically $20 to $100.


## What does Oshi Health treat?


Operating since 2019 ([Oshi about](https://oshihealth.com/about-us/) ), Oshi Health treats "hundreds of GI conditions" in US adults 18+ across all 50 states, with or without a diagnosis, including GERD, IBS, Crohn's, ulcerative colitis, SIBO, gastritis, bloating, constipation, diarrhea, liver conditions and GLP-1 GI issues ([Oshi join FAQ](https://oshihealth.com/join/faq/) ,[Oshi pricing](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) ). It excludes emergencies, urgent care, controlled substances ([Oshi terms](https://oshihealth.com/terms-of-use/) ), paperwork-only visits ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ), and in-house labs or scopes ([Oshi in-person care](https://help.oshihealth.com/medical-services-and-medical-records/how-does-oshi-handle-imaging-scopes-or-other-in-person-care/) ).


## Who treats you at Oshi Health?


Your first visit and follow-ups are usually with the same GI provider, a nurse practitioner or physician assistant "under the guidance of a gastroenterologist" ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ,[Oshi continuity](https://help.oshihealth.com/your-care-team/will-i-always-see-the-same-providers/) ), and teams["may include"](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) fellowship-trained gastroenterologists ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ). Nurse practitioners have graduate nursing training and physician assistants practice under physician supervision, depending on state law; gastroenterologists complete a three-year internal medicine residency and three-year GI fellowship ([MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/001933.htm) ,[ACP](https://www.acponline.org/about-acp/about-internal-medicine/subspecialties-of-internal-medicine/gastroenterology) ). GI providers prescribe to your chosen pharmacy and refer to dietitians or gut-brain specialists ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ,[What is Oshi Health](https://help.oshihealth.com/enrollment/what-is-oshi-health/) ).


## How do Oshi Health visits and labs work?


Oshi holds video visits by app or desktop link ([Oshi visits](https://help.oshihealth.com/enrollment/how-do-virtual-visits-work/) ), advertising "next-day availability" and reporting a six-day median wait in a 2026 study ([Oshi pricing](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) ,[Oshi JMIR release](https://oshihealth.com/newsroom/press-releases/oshi-health-publishes-peer-reviewed-study-of-11000-patients-validating-virtual-multidisciplinary-gi-care-at-scale/) ). Chat replies take "up to 1 business day" (8 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET daily) ([Oshi response time](https://help.oshihealth.com/your-care-team/what-is-the-typical-response-time/) ), alongside a 24/7 support line ([Oshi billing](https://oshihealth.com/billing/) ). Clinicians order Labcorp or Quest labs ([Oshi labs](https://help.oshihealth.com/lab-orders/lab-appointments/) ), mail breath tests ([Oshi mail kits](https://help.oshihealth.com/lab-orders/mail-service-labs/) ), and arrange outside scopes or imaging, where copays and deductibles may apply ([Oshi in-person care](https://help.oshihealth.com/medical-services-and-medical-records/how-does-oshi-handle-imaging-scopes-or-other-in-person-care/) ).


## How much does Oshi Health cost?


For most insured patients, care is billed in milestones as four in-network specialist visits for one year: the first GI visit, a dietitian or gut-brain visit, and a year of ongoing care billed as two visits ([Oshi billing](https://oshihealth.com/billing/) ). Most patients pay their specialist copay for the first visit ([Oshi cost help](https://help.oshihealth.com/enrollment/how-much-does-oshi-health-cost/) ), typically billed within 30 to 60 days ([Oshi bill timing](https://help.oshihealth.com/billing-and-payment/when-will-i-receive-a-bill/) ). One appointment can show as a "$700 bill to your insurance" covering 12 months of care ([Oshi $700 article](https://help.oshihealth.com/uncategorized/appointment-cost-hidden/) ), and deductibles apply ([Oshi pricing](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) ). Oshi takes "most major health plans" ([Oshi FAQs](https://oshihealth.com/faqs/) ), and its cost-estimate form lists Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross of Massachusetts and Cigna ([Oshi cost form](https://oshihealth.com/costquestions/) ), costs "as little as $0" via some employers ([Oshi cost help](https://help.oshihealth.com/enrollment/how-much-does-oshi-health-cost/) ), and excludes Medicare and Medicaid ([Oshi pricing](https://oshihealth.com/pricing-insurance/) ). Self-pay is $150 per visit with any clinician as of November 2026 (HSA/FSA eligible for most patients, outside deductibles) ([Oshi self-pay](https://oshihealth.com/paypervisit/) ). There is no long-term contract ([Oshi ending care](https://help.oshihealth.com/billing-and-payment/how-do-i-end-my-care-with-oshi-health/) ), and late cancellations within 48 hours may cost $50 ([Oshi cancellation policy](https://help.oshihealth.com/appointments-and-scheduling/visit-cancellation-policy/) ).


## What do Oshi Health reviews and studies show?


Oshi's app is rated[3.0 out of 5 from 128 ratings](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/oshi-health/id1518331430) on the US App Store and[3.4 out of 5 from 92 reviews](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.oshimobile&hl=en_US&gl=US) on Google Play as of November 2026. Oshi reports 98% satisfaction across 10,610+ visits and claims 92% "find relief in 10 weeks or less" ([Oshi approach](https://oshihealth.com/our-approach/) ); its 2023 trial of 332 patients, led by its chief medical officer, reported 92% symptom improvement ([Oshi 2023 trial](https://oshihealth.com/newsroom/press-releases/clinical-trial-demonstrates-oshi-improves-patient-outcomes/) ). Two 2026 studies co-written by Oshi staff reported symptom control rising from 20.2% to 86.6% in AJG (funded by Optum Labs and UCSF) and 92.4% improvement among 11,345 patients in JMIR ([Oshi AJG release](https://oshihealth.com/newsroom/press-releases/oshi-health-publishes-prospective-study-in-the-american-journal-of-gastroenterology-validating-improved-outcomes-and-reduced-healthcare-costs-through-virtual-multidisciplinary-gi-care/) ,[Oshi JMIR release](https://oshihealth.com/newsroom/press-releases/oshi-health-publishes-peer-reviewed-study-of-11000-patients-validating-virtual-multidisciplinary-gi-care-at-scale/) ).


## Oshi Health vs Nourish and Cylinder Health


[Nourish](https://www.nourish.com/does-my-insurance-cover-nutrition) provides insurance-covered registered dietitians, whereas Oshi adds nurse practitioners, physician assistants and gut-brain specialists.[Cylinder Health](https://cylinderhealth.com/) is a virtual GI service which has joined Hinge Health ([Cylinder Health](https://cylinderhealth.com/) ); its site serves employers and health plans and has a section for individuals.
